QUOTE: Don't hand-edit the switch blocks in `library/error.c`. They sit between `/* Begin Auto-Generated Code. */` and the end of the table, and are generated by `scripts/generate_errors.pl`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says not to hand-edit error.c and to regenerate it, but it says the new entry goes in a `/** */`-documented #define in the public header. It instead points to a "data_dir" input and admits it doesn't know where the entry goes.
